description: This Java source file defines the NettySslContextFactory class, which manages SSL/TLS context creation for client and server within the mockserver project, including configuration, trust management, and ALPN setup.

classes.name: NettySslContextFactory
classes.description: Manages creation and configuration of SSL/TLS contexts for client and server, including trust management, ALPN setup, and dynamic reloading based on configuration.

methods.name: withClientSslContextBuilderFunction
methods.description: Sets a custom function for building client SSL contexts.

methods.name: createClientSslContext
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a cached SSL context for a client, with options for forwarding proxy and HTTP/2.

methods.name: forwardProxyPrivateKey
methods.description: Retrieves the private key for the forward proxy, either from a PEM file or generated.

methods.name: forwardProxyCertificateChain
methods.description: Retrieves the certificate chain for the forward proxy, either from a PEM file or generated.

methods.name: jvmCAX509TrustCertificates
methods.description: Builds a trust chain from JVM default trust managers and additional certificates.

methods.name: customCAX509TrustCertificates
methods.description: Builds a custom trust chain including specific certificates and additional trust anchors.

methods.name: createServerSslContext
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a cached SSL context for the server, including certificate management and configuration.

methods.name: configureALPN
methods.description: Configures Application-Layer Protocol Negotiation (ALPN) for HTTP/2 and HTTP/1.1 support.

methods.name: trustCertificateChain
methods.description: Builds a trust chain from a specified PEM file.

methods.name: isForServer
methods.description: Indicates whether this factory is configured for server mode.
